_readme: Declarative map of published Google Sheet tabs to generated JSON. Run `npm run sync-content` to pull. Full spec + worked example: docs/content-sheet.md. Keys starting with _ are documentation and ignored by the script.

_tabSchema.key: required string. Stable identifier for the tab; also the value for `--tab <key>`.
_tabSchema.description: optional string. Free-text note about what lives in this tab.
_tabSchema.csvUrl: required string. The tab's published CSV URL (File > Share > Publish to web > pick the tab > Comma-separated values). Must end in output=csv. Publishing makes the tab publicly readable.
_tabSchema.output: required string. Bare .json filename written under outDir. No slashes.
_tabSchema.requiredColumns: optional string[]. Each must exist in the header row AND be non-empty in every data row, or the sync fails and writes nothing.
_tabSchema.columns: optional object. Column name -> type: string (default), number, boolean, string-array (splits on |).
_tabSchema.sortBy: optional string. Column to sort rows by. Defaults to `order` when that column exists; omit both and rows keep sheet order (the script warns).
_tabSchema.ignoreColumns: optional string[]. Columns present in the sheet but kept out of the JSON. May not overlap requiredColumns, sortBy, or groupBy.column.
_tabSchema.groupBy: optional object { column, references? }. Emits `groups` (a map of column value -> rows) instead of a flat `rows` array — the child half of a parent/child pair. `references: { tab, column }` additionally asserts every value has a matching parent row.

_exampleTabs.description: One row per school. Parent of the `coursework` tab.
Many rows per school, joined to `education` on school_id.
